name: not-found-page
title: 404 page
description: The 404 page template, built only from library items: a centered hero with the light flowing in from the corners, the headline as a plain sentence, the search bar and the way home.
use_for: A website's not-found page. The search bar's query goes to `onSearch` (React) or the `search` event (web component).
never: New colors, shadows or type sizes added to a section: use the items' props
More than one White button in a section
A joke or an error code as the headline
source: Built from the library (site header, hero block, search bar, button, footer row); the voice from the assets' copy

files.content:
import { Button } from '@/react/components/ui/Button' import { SearchBar } from '@/react/components/product/SearchBar' import { FooterRow } from '@/react/components/site/FooterRow' import { SiteHeader } from '@/react/components/site/SiteHeader' import { HeroBlock } from '@/react/components/blocks/HeroBlock' import { notFoundContent, type NotFoundContent } from '@/lib/pages/not-found' import { cn } from '@/react/lib/cn' // The 404 page from library items: a centered hero with the light flowing in from the corners, the headline as a // plain sentence, the search bar and the way home. The page fills the window, the footer at the foot. `content` // replaces the copy (lib/pages/not-found.ts); `onSearch` receives the query. export interface NotFoundPageProps { content?: NotFoundContent onSearch?: (query: string) => void className?: string } const WRAP = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-page-wide px-12 max-sm:px-4' export function NotFoundPage({ content: c = notFoundContent, onSearch, className }: NotFoundPageProps) { return (
{c.home.label}} placement="center" light="corner" className="flex-1">
) } export default NotFoundPage

// The 404 page template's copy: short declarative sentences, a search and the way home. Both flavors read this file.
const nav = [
	{ label: 'Product', href: '/product' },
	{ label: 'Pricing', href: '/pricing' },
	{ label: 'Changelog', href: '/changelog' },
	{ label: 'Blog', href: '/blog' },
]
const footer = {
	domain: 'spyglass.so',
	links: [
		{ label: 'Product', href: '/product' },
		{ label: 'Pricing', href: '/pricing' },
		{ label: 'About', href: '/about' },
		{ label: 'Changelog', href: '/changelog' },
		{ label: 'Blog', href: '/blog' },
		{ label: 'Terms', href: '/legal' },
	],
}
const header = { nav, secondary: { label: 'Sign in', href: '/sign-in' }, cta: { label: 'Get 50% off', href: '/pricing' } }

export const notFoundContent = {
	header,
	eyebrow: '404',
	headline: 'This page is not here.',
	body: 'The link may be old or mistyped. Search for what you came for, or go home.',
	search: 'Search creatives, brands and creators',
	home: { label: 'Go home', href: '/' },
	footer,
}

export type NotFoundContent = typeof notFoundContent

import { html } from 'lit' import { DsElement, define, HostLayoutController } from '@/elements/lib/element' import { notFoundContent, type NotFoundContent } from '@/lib/pages/not-found' import '@/elements/components/ui/button' import '@/elements/components/product/search-bar' import '@/elements/components/blocks/hero-block' import '@/elements/components/site/footer-row' import '@/elements/components/site/site-header' import styles from 'virtual:tw' // NotFoundPage.tsx as : the light from the corners, the plain sentence, the search bar and the way home, filling the window. `content` replaces the copy; the search bar's `search` event carries the query. const WRAP = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-page-wide px-12 max-sm:px-4' /** * @summary The 404 page template. */ export class NotFoundPage extends DsElement { static styles = [DsElement.styles, styles] protected readonly layout = new HostLayoutController(this, () => this.renderRoot.querySelector('[data-ds="not-found-page"]')) static properties = { content: { type: Object } } /** The page's copy (lib/pages/not-found.ts by default). */ content: NotFoundContent = notFoundContent render() { const c = this.content ?? notFoundContent return html`
${c.home.label}
` } } define('not-found-page', NotFoundPage)
